films.title: The Bachelorette Party
films.synopsis: On the eve of her wedding, Aleeza and her bridesmaids gather for a night of drinks, laughter, and a classic game of dares—the King’s Game. But when Kyoko discovers a mysterious cross in their Airbnb, a dark curiosity awakens within the group. Faced with impossible choices and mounting terror, Aleeza must confront the horrifying reality that some games are never meant to be played.
films.funFact: This was an assignment for FILM 250, and got into the Kingston Film Festival!
